snapshot.text: Finnair, the Finnish network carrier, closed FY2025 with revenue broadly unchanged at {{revenue@FY2025}} as prolonged industrial action in the first half weighed on the comparable operating result.
Net leverage fell by {{net_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{net_leverage@FY2025}} as net debt was reduced by {{net_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{net_debt@FY2025}}.
The point to watch is profitability: the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}, the weakest of the network peers ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2025}}).

credit_metrics.text: EBITDA fell by {{ebitda.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda@FY2025}} on revenue of {{revenue@FY2025}}, and operating profit declined by {{operating_profit.change@FY2025}} to {{operating_profit@FY2025}}.
Total debt was reduced by {{total_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{total_debt@FY2025}}, but gross leverage rose by {{gross_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{gross_leverage@FY2025}} as EBITDA fell.
Interest coverage improved by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2025}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2025}}, though it remains below the peer median of {{interest_coverage.peer_median@FY2025}}.

Cash generation weakened: FFO fell by {{ffo.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo@FY2025}}, taking FFO to debt down by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}}, and free cash flow declined by {{fcf.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf@FY2025}}.

FCF to debt fell by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}}, in line with the peer median, while capex intensity eased by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}.

operating_performance.text: Passengers were broadly unchanged at {{passengers@FY2025}}, up {{passengers.change@FY2025}}, with the fleet stable at {{fleet@FY2025}} aircraft and an average age of {{fleet_age@FY2025}}.
The fuel share of costs fell by {{fuel_share_of_costs.change@FY2025}} to {{fuel_share_of_costs@FY2025}}, above the peer median of {{fuel_share_of_costs.peer_median@FY2025}}.
Costs related to environmental regulation increased significantly during the year, with greater use of sustainable aviation fuel and changes to the EU Emissions Trading System weighing on the result.
During the year Finnair purchased leased A321 aircraft, and all aircraft were in operative use at the balance sheet date.

liquidity_funding.text: Liquidity rose by {{liquidity.change@FY2025}} to {{liquidity@FY2025}}, of which cash and cash-like investments of {{cash_like@FY2025}} were up {{cash_like.change@FY2025}}.
Undrawn committed facilities were stable at {{undrawn_facilities@FY2025}}, so liquidity to revenue rose by {{liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}.

Advance ticket cover fell by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, in the middle of the peer group, while contract liabilities rose by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}}.
Towards the end of the year Finnair issued a bond to further strengthen its financial position and support the execution of strategic investments.

peer_positioning.text: Finnair's strongest position is cash liquidity to revenue of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, the highest of the network peers ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2025}}) against a median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2025}}.

It is weakest on profitability and leverage: the EBITDA margin of {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} and gross leverage of {{gross_leverage@FY2025}} both rank last of the group ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2025}} and {{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2025}}).
FCF to debt sits in the middle of the group, and net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2025}} is in line with the peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}}.

watch_items.text: Profitability: the EBITDA margin of {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} is below the peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2025}}, and the industrial action in the first half weighed on the result.

Cash generation: FFO to debt fell by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}}, below the peer median of {{ffo_to_debt.peer_median@FY2025}}, and FCF to debt fell by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}}.
Leverage: gross leverage of {{gross_leverage@FY2025}} is above the peer median of {{gross_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}}, the weakest of the group ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2025}}).

Costs: the fuel share of costs of {{fuel_share_of_costs@FY2025}} is above the peer median of {{fuel_share_of_costs.peer_median@FY2025}}, and environmental regulation costs increased significantly during the year.
